images.title: Every look in one gallery
images.description: Save your skin, model, cape, and outer layers as complete looks, then switch between them with a single click
images.alt: The My looks gallery with several saved looks, one active look, and actions to edit, duplicate, and delete each look

images.title: See skin compatibility at a glance
images.description: Badges show support for Ears, Fresh Moves, and Just Expressions and warn you about conflicts with active mods and resource packs
images.alt: The look editor with an Ears skin and an open tooltip warning about a conflict with facial animations

images.title: Build your look with a live preview
images.description: Choose your model from visual cards and customize your appearance across dedicated tabs, with a live preview right in the game
images.alt: The look editor with a large player preview, vertical tabs, and Classic and Slim model cards

images.title: Explore skin collections
images.description: Browse standard Minecraft characters, Mojang event skins, and resource pack collections with search and model filters
images.alt: The skin catalog with collections, a search field, and a Classic or Slim model filter

images.title: Import skins your way
images.description: Add files or direct links, find skins by player name or UUID, and bring over looks from launchers and other mods
images.alt: The skin import screen with player lookup, a direct link field, and buttons to import from a file, launcher, or another mod

images.title: Review your looks before importing
images.description: See which looks are new and which are duplicates, check skin compatibility, and select only the ones you want
images.alt: The import review screen with groups of new and duplicate looks, selected cards, and compatibility badges

images.title: Open your looks right from Minecraft
images.description: Click your player preview on the title screen or pause menu to open My looks
images.alt: The Minecraft pause menu with a preview of the current player to the right of the buttons

images.title: Custom capes and resource pack collections
images.description: Import capes, save them in your looks, and browse resource pack collections. These capes are visible only to you
images.alt: The cape tab in the look editor with custom capes, a Mojang collection, search, and an elytra filter

images.title: Find a cape with an elytra texture
images.description: Search capes by name, filter by whether they include an elytra texture, and preview the result
images.alt: The cape catalog with an elytra filter and a preview of the selected elytra

images.title: Choose where your appearance comes from
images.description: Configure Offline and Minecraft separately for skins and capes, enable the providers you want, and change their priority
images.alt: The Providers screen with skin and cape tabs, Offline and Minecraft entries, and a player preview

images.title: Keep changing your look offline
images.description: Create and apply looks locally. Syncing with your Minecraft profile can wait until your game session is available again
images.alt: The skin providers tab showing different skins for Offline and Minecraft, with the local skin displayed in the player preview
